comments.text: Northern Norway is fascinating because modern infrastructure has not erased the old dependence on the sea. 🇳🇴❄ Villages in Lofoten may now be connected by bridges, tunnels and ferries, but fishing seasons, weather and daylight still shape everyday routines.
